opening.argument: The video describes an ordinary Target retail promotion: “when you spend $20 you get a $5 gift card back at target.” The speaker also offers her own $5 gift card to an interested viewer, stating, “I still do have a $5 gift card that I would pass on to anyone who wants to use it.” Entry requires only audience engagement: “the only thing that you need to do is like this video you need to subscribe and just comment in the section below.” These are straightforward promotional and giveaway conditions, with selection through a gift-card drawing, not a request for payment, credentials, or financial participation.
